title: Cascade Ortho Rider Certificate — Retention Phase Portion When a Case Moves
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders: the retention phase of a moved case.**

The part of the allowed case fee that pays for the retention phase at the end of treatment is always still to come when a case moves. In the recognised remaining-treatment fee it is therefore kept whole, and it is not reduced by the share of treatment still to come.

| Appliance on the case | Retention part of the allowed case fee |
|---|---|
| fixed braces | 10 percent |
| clear aligners | 5 percent |
| limited or interceptive, or any other case | nothing |

The appliance type is read from the case's establishment entry.

*Hypothetical example:* for a fixed-braces case with an allowed case fee of 4,730.00, the retention part kept whole is 473.00. For an aligner case with the same fee it is 236.50. For a limited case there is none.
